svg.title: Sprites Sandbox: your agent's commands run in a persistent Fly.io Sprite
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. SpritesSandbox's get_workspace hook gives the run a persistent Fly.io Sprite as ctx.workspace, so each command and file operation goes over the Sprites API, authenticated with SPRITE_TOKEN, and runs in the Sprite as the sprite user; output comes back to the tool. The first use creates the Sprite, its WorkspaceRef is saved in the message history and on the result, a later run reattaches with it, and destroy(ref) deletes it. A Sprite has no lifetime limit: it sleeps when idle, keeps its files and installed packages, and wakes on the next command.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SpritesSandbox gives the run a Sprite as its workspace, so the shell and file tools run there instead of on your machine.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Sprite has no lifetime limit and costs money until you delete it.
